name: fla_layernorm_gated
description: fla_layernorm_gated(x, g, weight, bias, activation='swish', eps=1e-5, is_rms_norm=True) -> out. x and g have shape [rows, dim]. weight and bias are [dim] tensors or None; both are required arguments but may be None. In fp32, compute x_hat = x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) when is_rms_norm is true, otherwise x_hat = (x - mean(x)) * rsqrt(var(x) + eps). Apply y = x_hat * weight + bias, skipping None terms. For activation 'swish' or 'silu', y = y * g * sigmoid(g); for activation 'sigmoid', y = y * sigmoid(g); other activation names leave y ungated. Returns a newly allocated tensor with x.dtype and shape [rows, dim]. No input mutation. The exercised dtype is bfloat16, including RMSNorm, LayerNorm, swish, sigmoid, bias-present, and bias-absent cases.
